summary: Sprint 29 (in-app + email notifications for action plan changes) tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed. Frontend: NotificationBell component works correctly across all critical flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4133 lines - exceeds 700 line guideline; recommend splitting (notifications/auth/audit/etc into modules) in a future refactor.
_notify_action_plan_change recipient query has odd `{'_unused': True}` dummy clause when responsible empty - works but smells; cleaner to build $or list conditionally.
Frontend NotificationBell polls every 30s with no cleanup pause when tab hidden - consider document.visibilityState gating to save CPU/network.
document.title flash never resets to 'TraciumSST' until unread reaches 0 again - if user opens app with unread, title stays prefixed even after mark-read until full re-render. Minor UX nit.
Email send is awaited inside the asyncio.create_task loop but any send failure won't surface - logger.warning only. Acceptable for fire-and-forget.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (bell visible, badge counts, panel open, click->navigate+markread, X delete, mark-all-read)

test_credentials: Used admin@traciumsst.com / TraciumSST2026! and sgsst_ui@test.com / Mgr2026!. Login endpoint is /api/auth/login-email (not /api/auth/login) - returns user object + httpOnly session_token cookie. Documented in test file.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test action plans (TEST_NOTIF) for sgsst_ui to trigger admin notifications. They remain in DB but won't impact other tests; can be cleaned with action='TEST_NOTIF' / 'UI TEST' / 'TEST sprint29' filter.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth login uses POST /api/auth/login-email with cookies (session_token). Use r.cookies.get('session_token') and pass as Authorization: Bearer for subsequent API calls. NotificationBell data-testids: notif-bell-btn, notif-bell-badge, notif-panel, notif-mark-all-read, notif-item-<id>. Bell click via page.evaluate to bypass Emergent badge overlay. Free Resend tier only delivers email to stephaniaceballosmendoza@gmail.com (not tested via SMTP - in-app notifications validated and always work).
verified_flows: POST /api/action-plans -> admin gets action_plan_created notif; sgsst_ui (actor) does NOT get notif for own action
POST /api/action-plans/{id}/follow-up -> action_plan_follow_up with note text in message
GET /api/notifications returns {items, unread_count} sorted DESC with all required keys
PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read marks read; 404 for invalid id
POST /api/notifications/mark-all-read marks all and returns {ok, updated}
Frontend bell shows badge=1 for admin, no-badge for sgsst (actor)
Panel opens with 7 items, X button deletes one (count -> 6), item click navigates to /audits and marks read, mark-all-read clears badge
